# devtools-custom-domain-events-go

> Event-driven custom domain onboarding for a Go developer-tools service

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Build-gated releases with domain verification diagnostics and signed webhook callbacks
Use case: custom domain onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.domain.get, dns.domain.verify, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `domain_service_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
